conventions.convention: p counts arcs and t=n−2p counts defects. Complex criticality uses κ=ord(q²), with κ=∞ for infinite order; criticality is κ finite and κ dividing t+1. At q=±1, κ=1 although the recurrence quantum characteristic is ∞.
For a noncritical label t+1=kκ+r with 1≤r<κ, the adjacent reflected arc label is p+r−κ and is present exactly when it is nonnegative.
Spencer support uses the mixed-radix digits of N+1, places s₀=1 and sᵢ=ℓPⁱ⁻¹, and a positive highest sign. Characteristic zero uses only places 1 and ℓ; ℓ=∞ gives singleton support.
At positive even rank with δ=0, the perfect-matching standard has zero ordinary form quotient but is an actual simple module. Decomposition formulas index only nonzero cell-form quotients.
Forest candidate coefficients evaluate the hook polynomials at −δ for the positive-loop diagram convention.
Closure trace is unnormalized: Tr₀(1)=1 and Trₙ(1)=δⁿ. The normalized trace δ⁻ⁿTrₙ is used only when δ is invertible.
The specified tilting category uses all divided powers and full integral-weight toral characters, q=e^(πi/ℓ), s=e^(πi/(2ℓ)), and the coproduct Δ(E)=E⊗K+1⊗E, Δ(F)=F⊗1+K⁻¹⊗F.
General pivotal negligibility uses the left pivotal trace. Right tensor closure is unconditional; left tensor closure is asserted under equality of both pivotal traces or existence of a braiding.

The ribbon comparison uses TL(−δ), Uᵢ=−eᵢ, and planar pivotal structure multiplied by tensor parity. The self-dual cup/cap loop remains −δ, while the corrected pivotal dimension of V is +δ. Countable choice is assumed only for the cited framed-tangle universality theorem.

load_bearing.statement: The polynomial hook candidates vₐ,ᵦ have chain coefficient 1, compose by B((a−c)/2,(a−b)/2)(−δ), and induce nonzero standard-module homomorphisms under the stated strict place-value wall inequalities.

The central reflection-invariant Fₙ acts on Vₙ,ₚ by q^(n−2p+1)+q^(−n+2p−1); the stated restriction and induction sequences split at noncritical labels, and adjacent reflected standards admit a nonzero map in the stated direction.

Hom(Δ(a),∇(b)) has dimension δₐᵦ and Ext¹(Δ(a),∇(b))=0; tensor products have the stated Weyl factors, filtration classes are summand-closed, and every finite tilting is a finite sum of the unique T(a), each occurring in V⊗a.
Under r>0 or δ≠0 or n=r=0, exact corner truncation sends Wₙ,ₜ and Dₙ,ₜ to Wᵣ,ₜ and Dᵣ,ₜ, and [Wₙ,ₘ:Dₙ,ᵣ]=[Wᵣ,ₘ:Dᵣ,ᵣ].
The support-character recurrence has nonnegative coefficients βₙ,ᵣ with βₙ,ₙ=1; every positive extra coefficient belongs to an actual simple Wₙ,ᵣ, and βₙ,₀=0 at positive even rank with δ=0.
When [2],…,[n] are units over a nonzero commutative ring, pₙ is the unique normalized two-sided annihilating idempotent, has corner Rpₙ, satisfies ptrₙ(pₙ)=([n+1]/[n])pₙ₋₁, and has closure [n+1].
For f=pℓ₋₁, the categorical tensor ideal generated by f has endomorphism component Jₙ=0 below ℓ−1 and Bₙ(f⊗1)Bₙ otherwise; ptrₙ(Jₙ)⊆Jₙ₋₁.
After quotienting by the tensor ideal generated by pℓ₋₁, retained paths give complete matrix units with diagonal trace weights [aₙ+1] and nondegenerate pairing, without a denominator [ℓ].
For every ℓ≥3 the finite integral R series defines the full tilting braiding and ribbon structure, with positive-K pivotal map, cV,V=sI−s⁻¹U and θV=s³I.

concerns.concern: Proof 3.1 says “Steps 1.1–2.2 therefore give” although there is no Step 2.2. The relevant root-limit computation is Step 2.1, which is correctly named in the trailing tags.

Proof 6.3 ends by asserting that attachment commutes with every generator “and that each resulting formal vector is killed by all generators.” The latter assertion needs an annihilated input: with s=r=1, attachment adds zero cups and is the identity on a basis matching E; the generator at E's adjacent cup acts as −T times E, which is nonzero generically. Step 7.1 uses an already annihilated hook vector, so the needed conclusion follows from the asserted commutation, but this qualification should be explicit.

seams_checked.note: The consuming page and items preserve the supplier's κ-versus-ℓ distinction, whole-product Gram specialization, normalized-trace nonzero-loop condition, and separate field-level quantum-binomial projector criterion. The ring-descent result supplies its own stronger ring argument.

The downstream page faithfully reuses the unit-denominator, boundary-ideal, fusion and signed ribbon interfaces. Its local Hecke-trace theorem uses the supplied closure identities with δ≠0 and Tᵢ↦qUᵢ−1; it preserves the distinction between the unreduced boundary image and its negligible quotient.
